issue.title: [bug] ⌘O opens Finder instead of the selected app when the sidebar is closed
issue.body:
**Where:** Desktop app (macOS) · **Version:** 1.33.0 · macOS 26.6

### What happened?

I picked VS Code once for a project via the "Open in" dropdown. With the right sidebar open, ⌘O opens the workspace in VS Code as expected. When the right sidebar is closed, ⌘O opens the workspace in Finder instead. I expected ⌘O to use the project's selected app regardless of sidebar state.

### Steps to reproduce

1. In a v2 workspace, choose VS Code from the "Open in" dropdown. ⌘O now opens VS Code.
2. Close the right sidebar.
3. Press ⌘O. The workspace opens in Finder.
